name: Elicit
shortDescription: AI research assistant. Plus is $11 per user per month billed annually.
longDescription: Elicit's pricing page calls it the AI research assistant. Plus is listed at $11 per user per month billed as $132 annually, with export formats. A try-for-free control is on the page, without a stated trial length.
